problems: Caption says 'glass rain' and 'glass drops', but no drop falls at any point in the storyboard: the glass balls are already lying on the ground in frame 1 and stay put through frame 16.

The 'sun spots' as pale pink coins don't read as light cast through the glass. The pink discs are scattered across the whole shaded ground, most of them nowhere near a glass ball (at-25, at-50). They look like flat pink chips or petals lying on the ground, not light. Only in frames 11-15 do a few white spots appear, and they have no visible source either.

The pig floats: at-25 it hangs upside down in the air with its legs up, cut through by the trunk. In frames 7-8 and 11 its feet are clearly off the ground. At-75 it hovers in the upper right with its legs dangling.
The crab clips into the trunk and floats: at-75 (and frames 12-13) it hangs in mid-air, wrapped around the trunk, legs dangling, with its party hat stuck in the canopy.

The camera runs into characters: frame 1 is filled by a sheep's woolly body, frame 2 is mostly sheep, and frames 4 and 16 are almost entirely blocked by the pig's body. The opening and the ending show nothing of the scene.

'my friends crowd in': the friends stay mostly behind the trunk in a cluster (at-50). Nobody walks toward the glass or the light spots or reacts to them, and a cluster of candy floats in the air above the blue character's head (at-25, at-50).
The shade under the tree is close to black and swallows the ground, so the pink spots look pasted onto a void rather than lying in dappled shade.
posts.critique: Nothing rains and the pink discs don't read as light coming through glass, so the caption describes something the film never shows. Floating, clipping animals and a camera stuck inside the sheep and the pig make it look broken rather than charming.
